add_library(contrib-libs-nanopb)


target_compile_options(contrib-libs-nanopb PRIVATE
  $<IF:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>,,-Wno-everything>
)

target_include_directories(contrib-libs-nanopb PUBLIC
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/contrib/libs/nanopb
)

target_sources(contrib-libs-nanopb PRIVATE

  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/contrib/libs/nanopb/pb_decode.c
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/contrib/libs/nanopb/pb_encode.c
)


set_property(

  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/contrib/libs/nanopb/pb_common.c
  APPEND

  COMPILE_OPTIONS
)

  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/contrib/libs/nanopb/pb_decode.c
  APPEND

  COMPILE_OPTIONS
)

set_property(

  APPEND
